changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,1 +1,5 @@
-Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.
+Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from.
+The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged.
+A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache.
+Same-session only.
+Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

changes.id:
filesystem.darwin/arm64.exec./bin/zsh -c -l SNAPSHOT_FILE=<claude-config>/shell-snapshots/snapshot-zsh-<n>-<id>.sh
      # No user config file to source
      

      # First, create/clear the snapshot file
      echo "# Snapshot file" >| "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"

      # When this file is sourced, we first unalias to avoid conflicts
      # This is necessary because aliases get "frozen" inside function definitions at definition time,
      # which can cause unexpected behavior when functions use commands that conflict with aliases
      echo "# Unset all aliases to avoid conflicts with functions" >> "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"
      echo "unalias -a 2>/dev/null || true" >> "$SNAPSHOT_FILE"

      

      
      cat >> "$SNAPSHOT_FILE" << 'CLAUDE_CODE_END_<id>'
# Check for rg availability
if ! hash rg 2>/dev/null && ! typeset -f rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  function rg {
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command rg ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
fi
# Shadow find/grep with embedded bfs/ugrep
unalias find 2>/dev/null || true
